title: Gold of oriflamme, di rimirar fe piu ardenti
html_source: An oriflamme is an ensign, banner, or standard, especially one that serves as a rallying point or symbol (Dictionary.com), something again that serves to inspire, galvanize, bring to action. “Di rimirar fè più ardenti” means “to behold is most ardent.” Looking upon certain images or symbols carries (wind-born?) with it a passion that drives those with eyes to see to express it with transcendent, visionary language. Except that age, enervation brought on by chronic remorse, life-weariness, and dimming light… you know.
